scope: Every tracked active *.test.cjs/js/mjs file, excluding historical .review snapshots. Soundtrack child suite runs rather than inheriting a recursive Node test context.

containment.windows: Real directory junctions. HEAD metadata uses a real file symlink where permitted, otherwise a verified junction with a diagnostic. No mock filesystem or machine policy change.
containment.linux: Required Linux CI exercises actual file symlinks.
containment.bugFound: Git for Windows traversed a foreign-project junction and changed the fingerprint when sibling contents changed. Bounded directory-entry preflight now rejects foreign redirects before Git. Repositories with unreadable, broken or more than 100000 inspected source entries fail closed.

linuxFollowUp.initialResult: Only phase2-worker failed: expected synchronous termination immediately after POSIX SIGTERM. All other active files, including real symlink cases, passed.
linuxFollowUp.fix: Wait for observed death of both owned parent and descendant. Windows still asserts the synchronous return; POSIX must pass the same real liveness checks without relying on immediate signal delivery.
